title: Why do they want to feel my pulse?
metaTitle: Why do they want to feel my pulse? - Si Shou Acupuncture and Wellness, PLLC
html: We look at your pulse a bit differently from what you are used to. Yes, we want to know the beats per minute and if it skips or is variable, however we also look for quite a bit more.  Each wrist has 3 positions on it which align with an acupuncture meridian.  There is an optimal level for each position (superficial, moderate, deep).  There is also a feel we are looking for.  In a normal pulse, it should be strong, with defined edges. It should not give with pressure but neither should it push back with a strong force.  The wave of the pulse has a feel to it as well.  In evaluating each position we can often get a sense of symptoms to expect and general health of that meridian.  We use this to corroborate with what else we are seeing.
